registration: Exact source/request/routes/limits/expected statuses and apply samples committed locally before implementation runs; server publication later. Development functional validation, not an external holdout or speed benchmark.
scope: One versioned envelope for signed conditional Boolean summaries and separately one source-bound physical-phase cell. Whole-source admission, exact guards/width/profile/selection; no cross-profile transfer.
direct: Extract only chronological positive native/derived dependencies and needed ground events, with independently checked term/event renumbering. Retain unresolved scoped lower models in their original PR44 format. No whole legacy model or pair separators built by the new route.
adapters: PR41/43/44 and PR42 retain their native certificates and guarantees. Coverage may be imported explicitly from an already produced proof; new build has no covered fallback. Compatibility fixture preparation is separate from new SDK construction.
runtime: check emits immutable process-local capability, not a receipt. apply uses only checked finite action, guards and exact width; no source execution. New signed consumers are assessed over exact capped-count/sign target classes, with explicit refinement_required if unsupported by the summary. Local phase apply is limited to checked requested cells.
safety: Independent fresh normal/-O checker blocks planner, producers, Java, SMT and whole-source positive evaluation; concrete negative witnesses are recomputed. Tampered interfaces/scopes/proofs and forward/cyclic/orphan dependencies rejected.
costs: Record one sequential functional run: backend work, export/pack/check and warm apply durations separately; do not infer speedups. All unsupported, budget, unresolved and negative cases retained.
gates: A1: forcing only explicit in physical-phase profile. A2: signed default no_lemmas; derived-lemma routes explicit.
preservation: All accepted PR44 bytes and modes except research/README.md, current research workflow and additive regression registry. Installed qkf unchanged. New F1 theorem and causal comparison remain separate PRs.
